about_lead: This site keeps every photo from Doll Weekend 14's official live photo album, so they stay available after the original album goes offline — and makes it easier to find the ones you're in.
about_event_body: Doll Weekend 14 (DW 14) took place on {dates} at the Renaissance Huizhou Hotel in Huizhou, Guangdong. For the event itself, see the official Doll Weekend site.
about_source_body: All {count} photos were taken by the event's official photographers and published in its live photo album on alltuu. They were downloaded at full resolution and checked against the album's own counts; two exact duplicate uploads were left out.
about_sets_body: Photographers filed their uploads into the album's categories as they went. Every photo was then looked over and the clear misfilings moved; stage events, which the album had mixed into Live Coverage, got a set of their own. Photos that could belong to either set stay where the photographer put them.
about_times_body: Times are the cameras' clocks, shown in China time (UTC+8) as at the event. Most come straight from the camera. {edited} photos were exported from editing software, so their time may be the export time instead, and {upload} photos have no shoot time at all — they show roughly when they were uploaded. Both are marked in the photo details.
about_downloads_body: Every photo can be downloaded as the original file from the live album: full resolution, with the album's watermark. Files are named after the camera's original file name plus the photo's ID, so two photographers' files never collide.
about_files_body: For download managers and scripts, there is also a list of every original with its download URL, file size and SHA-256 hash — to fetch photos in bulk and check they arrived intact:
about_scripts_body: To download every photo ({size}), there are two sample scripts that use this list:
about_scripts_py: Python 3.9 or newer, nothing to install
about_scripts_flag: Run without arguments, they only print help. To start downloading, add the flag below. Every file is checked against its SHA-256, and running the same command again skips finished files and continues interrupted ones.
about_usage_body: The photos belong to their copyright holders: the event's photographers and Doll Weekend. When you share one, please credit the photographer — their name is in the photo details and in the file's metadata.
about_code_body: The site's source code is on GitHub:
about_contact_body: For questions, corrections or anything else about the site:
about_hosting_body: The site runs on Cloudflare. Pages are rendered by a Cloudflare Worker, and the photos — {size} of originals plus thumbnails — are stored in Cloudflare R2. Thumbnails, preview images and original downloads are all served straight from R2 through Cloudflare's cache — originals under their own file names.
about_billing_body: On the Cloudflare Workers Paid plan ($5 a month), storing the photos adds well under $1 a month, and R2 doesn't charge for bandwidth — Cloudflare bills per request, not per byte — so viewing and downloading photos, even all of them, costs essentially nothing extra.
about_cost_note: Cloudflare's list prices as of {date}, leaving out the $5-a-month Workers Paid plan itself. Photos answered from Cloudflare's cache never reach R2, so most views aren't even counted as reads.
about_self_host_body: You can also download all the photos and the source code and deploy the site on your own Cloudflare account.
select_hint: Click photos to select up to {max}. Shift-click selects a range. Your selection is saved in this browser: changing filters, opening photos, visiting other pages or reloading won't lose it — it's still here next time you visit.
select_limits: Up to {download} can be downloaded here at once: each photo is saved as its own download, and too many at once can overwhelm the browser. With more selected, copy their links into a download manager.
selection_over_download: Each photo is saved as its own download, so {download} is the most we start at once — more would flood your downloads list, and the browser may stall, crash or leave files incomplete. Copy the links into a download manager instead, or remove some photos to download them here.
selection_multi_hint: Your browser may ask to allow multiple downloads.
selection_full: Selection full — {max} photos at most. Remove one to pick another.
